Players Committee card image of [[Kessel Run (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on Kessel; draw 'coaxium' destinies, stacking face up here until total > 12 (cannot deploy otherwise). During each move phase, if your smuggler here, move a 'coaxium' card from here to Used Pile. If no 'coaxium' cards here, retrieve 4 Force; place Effect out of play.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Kessel%20Run.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/Large/Kessel Run.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
